svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Housing: a round IP67 box about 76 mm across and 84 mm tall, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a base that can be drilled and four lid bosses on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 46 mm window in the centre of the base (hole saw, slow).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lens: a 60 x 6 mm PTFE disc (cut from rod or bought). Bed it on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: neutral-cure silicone over the window outside the base and hold it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with three M3 stainless screws on a 53 mm circle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill an M12 gland hole in the side, half way up, facing the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mount the radar module on its carrier on four standoffs inside the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base, its antenna face centred over the window.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the housing top screws to the head plate (four M4 countersunk).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The underside of the lens is the datum: 4,600 mm above the road.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lens flat and square to the housing; gland seals on a 10 mm cable.
